message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code loads models via BERTScorer, Comet, and PrismMetric without any checksum verification, pinned revisions, or authentication of remote sources.

No detected label flipping detection: The code performs no validation of label distributions, expected label sets, or label-noise detection; it only averages duplicate judgement scores and shuffles data.
No detected data poisoning defenses: There are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering steps applied to the training samples in any of the visible code paths.
No detected model integrity verification: Models are loaded via BERTScorer, Comet, PrismMetric, and other constructors without any hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision references.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense is present in the code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or robustness stress tests are present; the only 'OOD' module is SyntacticCompositionality which is imported but not shown performing adversarial evaluation.

No detected input sanitization: The code passes src_texts, references, and translations directly into metric computations with only length assertions in the Judgements constructor, but no shape/range/type validation or schema enforcement on incoming request data.
No detected output bounds checks: Metric scores (BERTScore F-scores, BLEU, METEOR) are returned and collected without any NaN guards, range checks, or sanity bounds on the numeric outputs.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although transformer-based models (BERTScore, Comet, Prism) are used, the pipeline is a metric evaluation system rather than a generative LLM interface, and no prompt-injection filtering, system-prompt isolation, or content moderation is implemented.
